notes:
Background: Ironbark is a mid-enterprise digital health company (patient triage + clinical summarization) evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to replace a patchwork of internal endpoints. They ingest PHI and must be HIPAA-covered. Key ask: full compliance mapping – SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA/BAA and notes on PCI applicability for small billing flows.

Call highlights (10/27):
- Sec+Legal joined; asked for explicit mapping doc that ties Redwood technical controls to our policy artifacts.
- Quote from CISO: "We cannot accept any off-net egress of PHI without encryption in transit and at rest and customer key control."
- Infra: wants VPC peering or PrivateLink + egress firewall rules; prefer customer-managed KMS (HSM-backed) and key rotation controls.
- Compliance: ISO 27001 certificate requested; SOC 2 Type II report + control matrix mapping.
- Billing team asked: confirm scope for PCI is limited to tokenization of payment card numbers; they may keep cardholder data out of the model pipeline.

Requirements summary (CRM style):
- Workloads: chat-based clinician assist, long-document summarization, embeddings for search. Low single-digit p50 latency targets for chat (200-500ms), high throughput for nightly embedding jobs (batch). Cost sensitivity moderate; willing to commit reserved capacity for predictability.
- Data residency: corporate mandate to keep EU-sourced PHI/process logs inside EEA. Need documented region processing guarantees and ability to pin model instances to eu-west-1 region.
- Audit logging: 7+ years retention for security/audit logs; logs must be exportable to Splunk/Seq. Need proof-of-concept for audit export pipeline.
- KMS: customer-managed keys (BYOK) required; integration with AWS KMS/HSM or equivalent; keys must be able to revoke and force re-encryption when rotated.
- Identity: SSO (SAML) + SCIM for provisioning; RBAC for model access and cost controls.

Compliance mapping ask (what they want from Redwood):
- SOC 2: provide Type II report, control mapping to their internal policy (data handling, change mgmt, incident mgmt), and gap notes on controls we need to overlay in the VPC deployment.
- ISO 27001: certificate + scope doc; statement of applicability.
- HIPAA/BAA: draft BAA to be reviewed by their legal; details about encryption (TLS 1.2+), access logging, breach notification SLA.
- PCI: high-level position: Redwood not expected to be a card processor; recommend tokenization before model ingestion and scope reduction guidance. Customer wants a short write-up.

Staged POC plan proposed:
- Phase 0: Security paperwork (receive BAA, SOC2/ISO artifacts) - target 2 weeks.
- Phase 1: VPC setup + peering + private endpoint (non-PHI test data) - 2 weeks.
- Phase 2: KMS BYOK integration test (rotate keys, confirm re-encryption flows) - 1 week.
- Phase 3: Small PHI pilot with audit logging to Splunk (30 days soak), security validation & pen-test coordination - 4-6 weeks.

Open items for sales/SE:
- Need architecture diagram that shows private control plane + customer data path and KMS call flows.
- Legal: send draft BAA and example SOC 2 Type II controls mapping doc.
- SE: prepare demo of audit log export to Splunk and proof of regional model pinning.

Notes appended: customers cares about explicit remediation ownership when gaps found. Keep messaging clear: private control plane + customer-managed KMS are the two main differentiators that will move deal forward.
